findings.candidate_quote: The 12-week randomized, placebo-controlled trial involved 44 participants, with 19 receiving the fiber mixture and 23 receiving maltodextrin as a placebo.
findings.reference_quote: 44 participants to be randomized to one of the intervention arms (fiber n = 21; placebo n = 23). After two dropouts in each group, 19 and 21 participants completed the fiber and placebo intervention, respectively
findings.explanation: The summary mixes the fiber completer count with the placebo randomized count. Allocation was 21 versus 23; completion was 19 versus 21.

findings.candidate_quote: patients with OBS <20 had a 42% higher risk of DKD (OR = 1.42, 95% CI: 1.06–1.91), and those with MMA ≥151 had a 113% higher risk
findings.reference_quote: The weighted univariate and weighted multivariate logistic association analyses were applied to evaluate the associations of OBS and MMA with the risk of DKD.
findings.explanation: The reported odds ratios indicate 42% and 113% higher odds, not equivalent percentage increases in risk. The summary converts the logistic association estimates into risk increases; its causality caveat does not correct this effect-measure error.
